origins.section: Every pywraplp Call Has a MathOpt Counterpart
MathOpt Keeps the Model Apart From the Solver
A Port Is Proved by a Test: Same Value at Zero Gap, and Each Plan Allowed by the Other's Rules

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-defaults: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-defaults: "MathOpt lets you leave them out, and a bound left out is infinite... Leave it out and the variable may go negative."
recorded.prompt:q-solvers: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-solvers: "A MathOpt model is built once and handed to each solver in turn"; the loop solves with HIGHS, GSCIP and CP_SAT.
recorded.prompt:q-gap: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-gap: "Fix the gap at 0 in both, so that 'optimal' means the same thing to both"; at gap 0 the medium run agrees on value and plan.

recorded.prompt:q-defaults:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.

recorded.outcome:q-defaults:d: NumVar maps to add_variable and IntVar to add_integer_variable, so add_variable is continuous.
recorded.prompt:q-solvers:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-solvers:b: "A pywraplp model lives inside one solver object... means three builds. A MathOpt model is built once".
recorded.prompt:q-solvers:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-solvers:c: The loop passes the same model with SolverType.CP_SAT, with no conversion.
recorded.prompt:q-solvers:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-solvers:d: The same loop hands the model directly to each SolverType; no LP export.

recorded.outcome:q-gap:a: "Is the port wrong? No. pywraplp passes SCIP a relative gap of 0.0001... inside it".
recorded.prompt:q-gap:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:b: "two optimal plans can differ... So compare values, not plans."
recorded.prompt:q-gap:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:c: Both runs were OPTIMAL; the difference comes from the gap tolerance, not a time limit stopping the search.
